text: Why XZMCXuzhou Medical University, situated in Xuzhou, Jiangsu Province (one of richest and most powerful province of China), it is an institution of higher education under the direct administration of Jiangsu Provincial Government. Established in 1958, XZMU has now become the center of medical education, medical service and medical research in the north of Jiangsu Province as well as in the whole Huaihai Economic Zone. The university has 14 affiliated hospitals, 24 undergraduate programs, and more than 11,000 students, of which more than 300 are international MBBS students, 19 master students and 14 doctoral students.CurriculumIntroduction to Nursing, Basic Nursing ,Internal Nursing, Surgery Nursing, Pediatrics Nursing, Emergency Nursing, Gynecological Nursing, Gerontological Nursing, Psychiatric and Nental Health Nursing ,Nursing Administration, Chinese Traditional Nursing, etc.Fee structureRegistration fee: 400 (pay at registration)Tuition fee: 30 000/academic yearHostel fee: 4 600/person/academic year (double room)Others: pay required fees to the acceptors when processing physical exam, residence permit and insurance. All fees are not refundable and their use can’t be changed.Study Duration4 YearsDegree AwardedStudents complete the whole undergraduate study, and meet all the requirements of Bachelor’s Degree Granting Regulations, shall be awarded the Bachelor of Science.
